name: banking-experience-system
description: A domain-specific design system for banking and fintech in the UAE — bilingual Arabic/English (RTL/LTR), regulatory-aware, accessibility-first.
author: Saravanakumar (https://github.com/dezinebee)

scripts.test:tz: TZ=Asia/Dubai node tools/test-js.mjs && TZ=Asia/Dubai node tools/test-dom.mjs
scripts.audit: python3 tools/audit-a11y.py && python3 tools/audit-consistency.py && python3 tools/audit-theme.py && python3 tools/audit-states.py && python3 tools/audit-contrast.py
scripts.build: python3 tokens/build-tokens.py && python3 tokens/build-theme.py && python3 tools/build-docs.py
scripts.gates: npm run build && npm test && npm run test:tz && npm run audit

comment_entrypoints: No `main`/`exports`: bes.js is a classic browser script that assigns window.BES, not an ES module — advertising a module entry point would promise an interface it does not have. `style` is declared because it is true. `private: true` is deliberate: distribution is the GitHub Release zip built by `npm run pack:release`, not npm.
comment: The shipped library (assets/) is dependency-free by design. jsdom is a test-time dependency only — it exists so component behaviour is exercised in a real DOM rather than asserted about pure functions. The order in `gates` matters: the DOM pass writes docs/audits/dom-snapshots/, which the contrast audit then walks alongside the static pages.
